ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(10);
 RET NUMBER;
 P_WHERE VARCHAR2(100);

 CURSOR CHECK_ALL 
 IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM taameems, TAM_INSTRUCTIONS
 WHERE ( 
-- taameems.port_cd = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,taameems.port_cd)
-- AND (taameems.port_cd >0)
-- AND 
 (taameems.TAM_NUM = NVL(:TAM_NUM,taameems.TAM_NUM))
 AND (taameems.TAM_SUB1 = NVL(:TAM_SUB1,taameems.TAM_SUB1))
 AND (taameems.TAM_SUB2 = NVL(:TAM_SUB2,taameems.TAM_SUB2))
 AND (taameems.TAM_DATE = NVL(:TAM_DATE,taameems.TAM_DATE))
 AND (taameems.DOC_TYPE = NVL(:DOC_TYPE_LIST,taameems.DOC_TYPE))
 AND (TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.DOC_TYPE = taameems.doc_type )
 AND (TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.PORT_CD = taameems.port_cd )
 AND (TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.TAM_TAM_SEQ = taameems.TAM_SEQ )
 AND (TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.TAM_TAM_SEQ_DATE = taameems.TAM_SEQ_DATE )
-- AND (hijdate_db.hij_date_diff_in_days(hijdate_db.cur_hij_date , NVL(TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.INS_EXTEND_DATE,TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.INS_DUE_DATE)) < 0)
 AND (TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.STATUS_CODE = 9 )
 AND NVL(TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.INS_EXTEND_DATE,TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.INS_DUE_DATE) >= NVL(:start_dt,NVL(TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.INS_EXTEND_DATE,TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.INS_DUE_DATE)) 
 AND NVL(TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.INS_EXTEND_DATE,TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.INS_DUE_DATE) <= NVL(:end_dt,NVL(TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.INS_EXTEND_DATE,TAM_INSTRUCTIONS.INS_DUE_DATE))
 );
BEGIN
 V_COUNT := 0 ;
 
 OPEN CHECK_ALL ;
 FETCH CHECK_ALL INTO V_COUNT ;
 CLOSE CHECK_ALL ;
 

 

 if v_count > 0 then 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 --- ALAA FAWZY ---------------------
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DOC_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:DOC_TYPE_LIST);
 ----------------------------------- 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 
 -------
 IF :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID = 'SUPPORT' THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DISABLEPRINT',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 END IF;
 -------
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_TAM_DATE',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:TAM_DATE,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_TAM_NUM',TEXT_PARAMETER,:TAM_NUM );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_TAM_SUB1',TEXT_PARAMETER,:TAM_SUB1 );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_TAM_SUB2',TEXT_PARAMETER,:TAM_SUB2 );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_TAM_STATUS',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_SENT_TO_USER',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH ||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 

 else
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if; 
 exception 
 when too_many_rows then
 V_COUNT := 999 ;
 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 
END ;
